engagementRule: every source point remains complete; every derivation creates a linked point; every runtime finding returns to source lineage through Mirror Lane
promotionRule: promote only the exact contextual capability supported by evidence; never promote a word globally
returnRule: new meanings, contradictions, missing bindings and emergent relations become Mirror Lane proposals linked to every originating source point
globalStopRule: global stop requires a proven global safety, semantic or integrity invariant violation
